ABOUT DR. VIKAS SINGH

Dr. Vikas Singh is an internationally oriented hair restoration surgeon and cosmetic dermatologist, recognised for his expertise in advanced hair transplantation, aesthetic dermatology, regenerative medicine and anti-ageing treatments. With over two decades of professional experience, he brings together clinical knowledge, aesthetic precision and a personalised approach to patient care.

Based in Hong Kong at Santunman Center, Dr. Singh maintains an international professional presence through visiting consultancy engagements and associations across the Middle East, Asia and India. His professional interests encompass advanced hair restoration, minimally invasive aesthetic procedures, regenerative treatment approaches and comprehensive hair and skin rejuvenation.

With a commitment to innovation, refined clinical techniques and individualised treatment planning, Dr. Singh aims to deliver natural-looking aesthetic outcomes while maintaining a strong focus on patient assessment, safety and professional standards.
